tour.welcomescreen.lantern_fists.text: Left click with empty hands: a ten-hit combo. Hold it for a heavy blow with a giant fist.
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_clicks.title: New Ring Clicks
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_clicks.text: The shield is gone. Right click fires the bolt, hold for the Beam; hold the scan key for the dome.
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_axe.title: The Battleaxe
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_axe.text: A new weapon in the Construct Wheel: chops, a ground-splitting leap, a hook and a whirlwind.
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_saw.title: The Heavy Chainsaw
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_saw.text: A new weapon in the Construct Wheel: slashes, a grinding rend, an impale and a guard.
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_rpg.title: The Rocket Launcher
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_rpg.text: A new weapon in the Construct Wheel: rockets, a seeking cluster rocket, a blast jump and a rocket you steer.
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_shotgun.title: The Sawed-off Shotgun

tour.welcomescreen.hands_random.text: Giant Hands (Left Alt) now call up 1 to 5 hands at random in one use.
tour.welcomescreen.hand_gauntlet.title: The Infinity Gauntlet
tour.welcomescreen.hand_gauntlet.text: The snapping Giant Hand is the Infinity Gauntlet; its snap sends a ring of hard light out.
tour.welcomescreen.lantern_recharge.text: Recharge presses your ring to the new lantern: it whirs, crackles and lights up while your ring fills completely.
tour.welcomescreen.mech_combo.title: Six New Mech Blows

tour.welcomescreen.mech_armor.title: Armored in the Mech

tour.welcomescreen.escape_game.text: Caught in a cage or a grab? Click in time on the bar to break free.

tour.welcomescreen.one_hand.title: One Hand at a Time
tour.welcomescreen.one_hand.text: While fists, the Beam, Giant Hands, the Air Strike or a slam are going, other hand moves wait.
tour.welcomescreen.flight_wheel.title: Ranged Weapons in Flight
tour.welcomescreen.flight_wheel.text: In flight the Construct Wheel offers only weapons that fire from afar.
tour.welcomescreen.heat_gauge.title: Simpler Heat Gauge
tour.welcomescreen.heat_gauge.text: The flamethrower's heat gauge is only its filling half circle, without numbers.
tour.welcomescreen.beam_ash.title: Burnt to Ash
tour.welcomescreen.beam_ash.text: A creature the Beam kills burns to ash.
tour.welcomescreen.ram_cone.title: A Gentler Ram Cone
tour.welcomescreen.ram_cone.text: The ram cone in flight does 70% less damage but takes 70% off blows from the front.
tour.welcomescreen.mech_head.title: Bigger Mech Head
tour.welcomescreen.mech_head.text: The mech's head is bigger, and its punches land better.
tour.welcomescreen.mech_missiles.title: Crystal Missile Warheads
tour.welcomescreen.mech_missiles.text: The mech's missiles have crystal warheads; its eye beam fires while the missile arm is up.
tour.welcomescreen.mech_flamer.title: Mech Flamethrower Barrel
tour.welcomescreen.mech_flamer.text: For the mech's flamethrower the hand sinks into the wrist and a barrel slides out.
tour.welcomescreen.mech_roar.title: Quieter Mech Exhaust
tour.welcomescreen.mech_roar.text: The mech's exhaust flames no longer roar.
tour.welcomescreen.crosshairs.title: Living Crosshairs
tour.welcomescreen.crosshairs.text: Each character has its own crosshair: it widens as you strike, locks on creatures and flashes on hits.

tour.welcomescreen.fixes.text: Fixed: the mech pilot's arm, the panel, unseen fists and helpers, worn-down bodies and Doctor Octopus while down.

spell.welcomescreen.fireball.desc: Hurls a blazing fireball that bursts on impact, burning and knocking back every foe around it. Water puts it out.
spell.welcomescreen.lightning_strike.des: A storm gathers over your target, then lightning strikes, stuns foes close by and leaps on to up to 3 more (5 in the rain).
spell.welcomescreen.wind_gust.desc: Blasts a gale forward that throws foes back, turns their arrows round and blows loose items away. Softens your fall.
spell.welcomescreen.poison_area.desc: Shatters a vial into a bubbling cloud of poison that slows every foe inside; the longer they stay, the worse it bites.
spell.welcomescreen.void_walk.desc: Step into the void: invisible, silent and fast. Your first blow out of it strikes 50% harder and leaves the foe reeling.
spell.welcomescreen.welcome_tip: Feel free to send me whatever you want! I can make simple spells within 3min. Think of something and let me know, and I'll try to make it ASAP!
character.welcomescreen.green_lantern.su: A ring that shapes hard light: fists, bolts, weapons, giant constructs and flight. Everything costs ring power.
character.welcomescreen.green_lantern.ab:
Your ring turns your will into hard light. Everything it makes costs ring power: the bar in the bottom right shows how much is left, and the Dome, the Beam, a weapon, the mech or flight keeps draining it while it lasts. Recharge at your lantern when it runs low.

Left click throws your fists of hard light; right click fires bolts and the Beam. Your ability keys call the big constructs: the Emerald Express, the Giant Hands, the Light Cage, the ground slam and your ultimate, the Air Strike.

Double-tap jump to fly. In the air the Express key raises a ram cone, the Dome is a brake and the slam a dive.

The Construct Wheel gives you hard-light weapons: a sword and shield, a battleaxe, a chainsaw, a rocket launcher, a sawed-off shotgun, a flamethrower and, once unlocked, an energy whip, each with four moves on the mouse. Your other ring powers wait while you hold one.

Hold the scroll wheel to build the Hard-Light Mech over an enemy and pilot it.
character.welcomescreen.thor.summary: The god of thunder: fists and Mjolnir on the ground, lightning in the sky.
character.welcomescreen.thor.about:
On the ground you fight with your fists: a combo of punches and kicks, a dash, grabs and the Thunderclap. Press the scroll wheel to take Mjolnir from your belt: your attacks become hammer swings, throws and an uppercut. Press it again to hang the hammer back.

Double-tap jump for a huge leap, hold jump to fly. In flight you strike one-handed, and lightning gives you a shockwave, a blink, a dive, bolts from the sky and Lightning Speed.

Hold the scroll wheel to charge yourself, or the hammer in your hand, with lightning: your blows hit harder for a while.

Your first ability key calls up a thunderstorm that follows you: press it again to call bolts down where you aim. Your second makes you rise and burst as a lightning bomb.

As Thor you are 30% bigger than a normal player.
character.welcomescreen.doc_ock.summary: Four mechanical tentacles that strike, grab, throw and climb, and can carry you.
character.welcomescreen.doc_ock.about:
Your tentacles hit, use and place things from further away than your arms reach, and hook into walls: walk into a wall to climb it, crouch to hold still and jump to push off.

Grab up to four creatures, swing your view to smash them around and attack to throw them all. Slam the ground around you, strike with every free tentacle, reach through a portal, or mark creatures and burst up under them from the ground. Your ultimate, Rampage, doubles your attack speed and lets the tentacles fight by themselves.

Switch stance to walk on two, three or four tentacles: you run faster and jump higher, but fewer tentacles stay free for abilities.

Dashing, blocking and climbing use stamina.
character.welcomescreen.none: You are nobody right now (power wheel)
ability.welcomescreen.thor.combo.desc: A combo of punches, elbows and kicks, one blow per click, with big finishers once it builds up. With the hammer in hand it is a combo of hammer swings; in flight, of one-handed blows.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.thunderclap.d: You wind up and clap your hands: a thunderclap blasts everything in a cone ahead of you away. Let go before the wind-up is done and it is a normal combo blow.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.hammer_upperc: An upward hammer swing that launches whatever stands in front of you high into the air. A raised shield takes the blow, but its holder is knocked down.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.dash.desc: A fast, low dash along the ground the way you are moving, or straight ahead when you stand still.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.grab.desc: Grabs the nearest creature in front of you by the throat and holds it up. Within 1.5 seconds pick the finish: the attack button punches it, the use button throws it, the scroll wheel smashes its head into the ground. Pick nothing and one is chosen at random. Only while standing or walking.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.grab_dash.des: A dash straight ahead that catches whatever you pass. Pick a finish as with Grab, or leave it to chance: then it may also leap up with it and slam it down. Catching nothing, it is a normal dash. Only while running.
thor.welcomescreen.grab.title: Grabbed! Pick a finish
Throws the hammer at your crosshair. It hits hard, knocks its target back and flies back to your hand, hitting what it passes. Crouch as you throw and it stays where it stops: on the ground, stuck in a wall or hanging in the air.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.hammer_leap.d: Hold to draw the hammer back, longer to throw it further, and let go to throw it. It stays where it stops and lightning pulls you after it: near the ground you land by it, up in the air you catch it and fly on. No fall damage for a moment after.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.hammer_call.d: Calls your thrown hammer back to your hand. On its way it hits every creature in its path once. Stuck in a block, it tears itself free.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.hammer_follow: Lightning pulls you to your thrown hammer, if it is near enough; one still flying stops in the air for you. Near the ground you land by it with it in hand; up in the air you catch it and fly on.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.storm_throw.d: On the ground you fling the hammer up towards where you aim, dash after it on a streak of lightning, catch it, hold it high while the storm gathers in it and hurl it down just before the foe you aim at (else the nearest enemy there), then drop back down. In flight you only hold it up and hurl it, at most 6 blocks far, and hang in the air until it is back. Where it strikes, lightning runs out over the ground in a wide V that opens past the foe, hurting and flinging everything in it.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.mjolnir.desc: Takes the hammer from your belt into your hand, or hangs it back. Your attacks use the hammer while you hold it, and your fists while you do not.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.charged.desc: Lightning strikes you and charges you for a while. With the hammer in hand its blows and throws hit harder; without it your fists hit harder and you run faster.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.super_jump.de: A huge leap into the air. You hang at the top for a moment and can drift a little, then fall back down without fall damage.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.flight.desc: You fly where you look, pulled along by the hammer. With no keys held you hover; fly down onto the ground to land. A hard hit knocks you out of the sky.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.air_shockwave: A burst of lightning all around you that hurts everything nearby. All it hits, players and flyers too, drops to the ground limp and stays down for 3 seconds.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.air_blink.des: A short blink along a streak of lightning, the way you are steering or where you look. It stops short of walls.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.grab_dash_div: Dives at what you aim at, grabs it on the way and slams it into the ground with a strike of lightning. Ends your flight.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.air_bolt.desc: A bolt of lightning strikes the creature you aim at, even far away. Aimed at nothing, it does nothing.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.lightning_fli: You become a bolt of lightning and fly at enormous speed for a while, striking enemies you pass. Close over the ground you land by yourself with a strike that throws everything back.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.storm.desc: A thunderstorm gathers over you and follows you, with rain and a dark sky under it. Press again to call a bolt down where you aim; by itself it strikes foes under it now and then. Crouch and press to end it. Its cooldown starts once it is over.
ability.welcomescreen.thor.lightning_bom: You rise slowly into the air as bolts strike round you, charge for a moment and burst like a bomb of lightning: everything round and under you is hurt, thrown back and knocked down. Then you sink back down without fall damage. Only from the ground.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.grab.desc: A tentacle grabs the creature you aim at, or the nearest enemy ahead; press again for the next, up to four. Swing your view to smash them, attack to throw them all, crouch and press to let go.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.multi_tent: Every free tentacle strikes the creature you aim at, one after another. Aimed at nothing, they go for the nearest enemy in front of you.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.dash.desc: The tentacles launch you the way you are moving, or where you look when you stand still. Costs stamina; the landing never hurts.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.block.desc: All four tentacles hold an energy shield in front of you. It takes most damage from the front and stops projectiles and knockback, but slows you and drains stamina.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground_sla: The tentacles smash down around you and throw everything nearby back. In the air you dive down first for a bigger slam. While you hold creatures it drives them into the ground; crouch for the normal slam.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.portal.des: A tentacle goes through a portal, chases and grabs the creature you aim at, then slams it into the ground from a portal high in the sky. Your other tentacles keep working.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.rampage.de: Ultimate: for a while you attack twice as fast and all four tentacles attack nearby hostile creatures by themselves.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.stance.des: Switches between walking on your feet and on two, three or four tentacles. On tentacles you run faster and jump higher, the more legs the higher, but fewer tentacles stay free for abilities. Crouch to switch back.
ability.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground_str: Aimed at a creature it marks it, one mark per free tentacle. Aimed at nothing, the tentacles dive into the ground and burst up under every mark. Crouch and press to clear the marks.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.emer: A giant hard-light train comes out of a portal beside you and rams the enemies near you one after another, then derails and blows up. In flight the same key raises a ram cone instead.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.cons: Takes out a hard-light weapon: tap to swap between empty hands and your last weapon, hold to open the wheel and pick one. While you hold a weapon your other ring powers wait.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.rech: Puts power back into your ring at your lantern. Works on the ground and in flight; whatever the ring was doing stops meanwhile.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.ligh: Right click: a quick bolt of hard light where you aim. Hold instead for the Beam: a ray that goes through creatures and grows stronger, and costlier, the longer you hold.

Your fists wear gloves of hard light. Each click throws the next blow of a ten-hit combo at whatever is in reach; the tenth is a finisher. Hold for one of four heavy blows at random, each with a giant fist of its own.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.shoc: You smash the ground and a random giant construct strikes ahead of you with a shockwave. In the air you dive down first and take no fall damage.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.flig: You fly where you look, faster the longer you go. Flying drains the ring. Land by sinking onto the ground or flying into it, or double-tap again to drop.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.ring: A wave from the ring marks every creature around you, even through walls, coloured hostile, neutral or friendly, and tells you how many it found. Hold the key for the Light Dome, which guards you from every side; press again to lower it.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.air_: Ultimate: a hard-light gunship flies over where you look and pounds the enemies there with guns and missiles, then crashes in a huge blast. Needs open sky.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.gian: Calls up 1 to 5 giant hard-light hands at random, by the enemies round you, that smack, throw, slam or launch them. Hold instead for the Western Revolver Assembly: giant hands with a revolver.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.ligh: Locks the creature you look at in a hard-light cage that follows your aim; it cannot move or hurt anyone. Press again to pound it into the ground, or crouch and press to let it go.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.beam: Locks your firing Beam at the stage it has reached, so it stops growing. Press again to let it grow on.
ability.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech: Builds a giant hard-light mech over the nearest enemy ahead, stomping and clapping it as it forms, then you pilot it. Hold again to leave; it also breaks up by itself after a while.

guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.ground: Ground
Your normal state on foot once your arrival is done, with both hands empty.

Double-tap jump to fly.
Take out a weapon in the Construct Wheel.
Hold the scroll wheel to build the mech.
The game's own left and right click: with empty hands you do not mine, hit, place or use.
Hold any item to get those clicks back; your fists, bolt and beam then wait until both hands are empty again.
Punch
Throws the next blow of a ten-hit combo with gloves of hard light, 2 to 3 blocks far. The tenth is a finisher.
Heavy Blow
One of four heavy blows at random: a giant fist slams down, bursts from the ground, rams out on a piston, or you spin with swollen fists.
Shoots a light bolt from your ring where the crosshair points.
Light Beam
Charges up, then pours a beam of light from the ring until you let go. It grows through five stages, each hitting harder, reaching further and costing more; you walk slower the stronger it is.
While the beam fires: locks it at the stage it has reached, or lets it grow on.
Light Dome
Hold the scan key: a dome of light all around you. Press the key again to lower it.
Builds the Hard-Light Mech over the nearest enemy ahead, then you pilot it.

Tap: swaps between empty hands and your last weapon. Hold: opens the wheel; flick toward a weapon (or scroll to it) and let go to take it out, or right-click to close it. Forming a weapon costs power, and holding one drains a little.
Press your ring to your lantern's emblem to fill it again.

Smashes your fist into the ground and a giant construct strikes ahead.

Pound the Cage
Only with a creature caged: press the same key again to pound the cage into the ground three times, harder each time. The last slam breaks it.
Let It Go
Only with a creature caged: opens the cage and lets the creature go unharmed.
Your ultimate: a hard-light gunship pounds where you look.
Takes off into flight.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.flight: Flight
Double-tap jump, also in the middle of a jump or a fall.

Double-tap jump again (you fall from there).
Sink onto the ground, or fly into it while looking down.
Land a fast dive with a slam.
The beam, recharge and shockwave, for a moment during the take-off.

Flying drains the ring all the time; what you shoot or hold up comes on top.
When the ring runs dry you sink gently to the ground, unhurt; recharge it to fly again.
Stop Flying
Stops flying; you fall from there.
Punch
The fists' combo, as on the ground.
Heavy Blow
A heavy blow at random, as on the ground.
A light bolt that carries your own speed along.
Light Beam
The beam, for strafing runs; it grows through its stages as on the ground.
Locks the beam at the stage it has reached, or lets it grow on.
Ram Cone
A pointed ram cone ahead of you that rams whatever you fly into; press again to lower it. Low over the ground it scrapes and costs extra power.
Brake
Hold the scan key: the dome opens as a brake chute and halves your speed.
Builds the mech on the ground by the nearest enemy ahead and ends your flight.
Dive
Dives straight down and slams where you land; you stay down on one knee until it is done.
Recharges the ring while you keep flying.
Takes out a ranged weapon or puts one away; close-range weapons wait for the ground.

Your ultimate: a hard-light gunship pounds where you look.
Pound the Cage

guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.i:
Hold the scroll wheel with empty hands and ground under you.
It takes about 14 seconds to build while the camera films it; you cannot move or strike until it is done.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.o:
Hold the scroll wheel again.
It also breaks up by itself after a while, when the ring runs dry, or when you die.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.b:
Every other power and ability key (they tell you how to leave).
The game's own crouching.
Striking or firing while the mech climbs.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.n:
Piloting drains the ring a little all the time.
The mech stands still while it strikes; firing its eyes or aiming its missiles it walks but cannot run.
The missile arm, the flamethrower, the helpers, the rocket boots and the spin each wait a while after use.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.c: Walk into a ledge or wall too high to step onto and the mech climbs it, hands over the top.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.b: The next blow of a three-hit combo: a straight right (a stomp with an enemy at its feet), a backhand sweep, then a double-fist slam, or a grab, smash and throw with an enemy in reach.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.e: Click: a bolt of light out of each eye slit strikes what you aim at and throws the first enemy back.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.g: Hold: a blade of light out of the eyes burns everything in it for as long as you hold, 3 seconds at most.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.m: The mech aims its right arm at your crosshair and the back of its hand opens on five missiles.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.f: While the arm aims: each click fires one missile at what you aim at, and it bursts there; 5 at most.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.l: Press again to shut the hand and lower the arm.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.s: The mech folds its legs and kneels, its torso spinning round for 3 seconds, fists swinging and hammering the ground.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.f: Standing still: a flamethrower grows over the right fist and pours fire where you aim, 10 seconds at most.
Press again to shut the flamethrower early.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.h: The hatch under the cockpit opens and 3 robots twice your height drop out; they punch, shoot and leap at enemies until they fall or you leave the mech.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.j: The mech leaps up once and lands with a thud; double press for its rocket boots.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.r: Rockets out of its soles carry the mech up for 5 seconds at most: jump climbs, crouch sinks, then it falls.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.d: In the air: the mech swings both fists up and crashes down into the ground, blasting everything round it.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.c: Double press again in the air to cut the rockets and fall.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.mech.l: Leaves the mech: it breaks apart and you float down.
Take it out in the Construct Wheel, or tap the wheel key to bring back your last weapon.

Tap the wheel key again, or pick another slot.
With the ring empty it breaks up.

Your other ring powers (they ask you to put the construct away first) and building the mech.
The shield charge, in flight.
Forming it costs power and holding it drains a little.
One of twelve cuts and thrusts, a different one each click.
Shield up before your chest while you stab very fast all over the front, until you let go.
You rush straight ahead, ram everything aside and slam the shield into the ground. Click again during it to slam early.
Blocks with the shield square in front of you for as long as you hold. A cut or the flurry lowers it while they last.
Tap to put the sword away; hold to open the Construct Wheel.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.flamet: Take it out in the Construct Wheel.

Tap the wheel key, or pick another slot.
With the ring empty it breaks up.

Your other ring powers and building the mech.
A second fire move while one burns.
Forming it costs power and holding it drains a little.
A wide sweep of flame from one side to the other; the next click sweeps back.
A roaring stream of fire at the crosshair while you hold. Held too long it overheats and must vent before it fires again.
Lays a line of fire that bursts up into a wall of fire in front of you. It needs ground there.
A fire vortex spins around you while you hold; letting go blasts it outward.
Tap to put the flamethrower away; hold to open the Construct Wheel.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.i: Take it out in the Construct Wheel.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.o:
Tap the wheel key, or pick another slot.
With the ring empty it breaks up.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.b: Your other ring powers and building the mech.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.n: Forming it costs power and holding it drains a little.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.l: One of the whip's lashes, a different one each click; a crack of the tip hits harder.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.w: Whirls the lash round you while you hold, hitting every hostile creature it passes; letting go cracks it hard ahead.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.l: Throws a lasso at the creature you aim at and smacks it down at your feet, slowed. One that catches nothing costs as much as a lash.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.s: Spins the lash before you as a shield while you hold: hits from the front do much less.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.whip.w: Tap to put the whip away; hold to open the Construct Wheel.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.battle: Take it out in the Construct Wheel.

Tap the wheel key, or pick another slot.
With the ring empty it breaks up.

Your other ring powers and building the mech.
In flight it cannot form.
Forming it costs power and holding it drains a little.
Three heavy chops in turn, through everything in front of you: down, back across, then overhead.
Leap forward and drive the axe into the ground: it splits ahead, throwing everything on it up and down.
Hook the creature ahead with the axe's beard and yank it to you.
Spin with the axe while you hold, cutting all round; nothing knocks you back. Letting go ends in a wide swing.
Tap to put the battleaxe away; hold to open the Construct Wheel.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.chains: Take it out in the Construct Wheel.

Tap the wheel key, or pick another slot.
With the ring empty it breaks up.

Your other ring powers and building the mech.
In flight it cannot form.
Forming it costs power and holding it drains a little.
A fast diagonal slash; the teeth bite and slow what they hit. The next click slashes back.
Drive the running blade into the creature ahead and grind it while you hold; you both stand still.
Thrust the tip in, let it chew a moment, then throw the creature off it.
Hold the running blade across you: blows from the front are ground away and shots shredded.
Tap to put the chainsaw away; hold to open the Construct Wheel.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.rocket: Take it out in the Construct Wheel.

Tap the wheel key, or pick another slot.
With the ring empty it breaks up.
Your other ring powers and building the mech.
Forming it costs power and holding it drains a little. It forms in flight too.
A rocket straight where you aim; its blast hurts and knocks down everything near it.
Shoulder it while you hold, let go to fire: it bursts into five bomblets that curve onto red creatures.
Fire into the ground at your feet: the blast throws you up and forward, and you land softly.
Hold to fire a rocket that flies where your crosshair points; let go and it bursts.
Tap to put the launcher away; hold to open the Construct Wheel.
guide.welcomescreen.green_lantern.shotgu: Take it out in the Construct Wheel.

Tap the wheel key, or pick another slot.
With the ring empty it breaks up.
Your other ring powers and building the mech.
Forming it costs power and holding it drains a little. It forms in flight too.
One barrel of pellets: deadly up close, weaker further off. Many pellets knock a creature down.
Hold to cock both hammers, let go to fire both at once: a wide blast that kicks you back.
Drive the stock into the creature ahead and knock it off its feet.
Hold the barrels up: shots from the front are stopped and blows dulled. Letting go fires a short wide blast.
Tap to put the shotgun away; hold to open the Construct Wheel.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.title: Fists
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.in: Your normal state on the ground, the hammer on your belt.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.out:
Press the scroll wheel to take up the hammer.
Hold jump to fly.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.blocked: Ability keys 3 to 12: nothing is on them yet.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.combo: The next blow of your fist combo: punches, elbows and kicks, with big finishers later on.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.clap: Winds up and claps: a Thunderclap blasts away everything in a cone where you aim.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.dash: Dashes low along the ground the way you walk, or straight ahead when you stand still.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.grab: Grabs the nearest creature in front of you by the throat. Then pick a finish within 1.5 seconds (see Holding), or one is picked at random.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.grab_dash: Dashes straight ahead and grabs whatever you pass. Pick a finish as with Grab; left to chance, it may also leap high with it to slam it down.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.hammer: Takes the hammer from your belt into your hand.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.charge: Lightning charges you: harder fists and faster running for a while.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.jump: A huge leap: you hang at the top a moment and can drift a little, then fall back down without fall damage. Hold jump up there to fly.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.storm: Calls up a thunderstorm over you that follows you, with rain and a dark sky under it. Now and then it strikes foes under it by itself.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.bomb: You rise slowly with bolts striking round you, charge up and burst: everything round and under you is hurt, thrown and knocked down. Only on the ground.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.storm_thr: Flings the hammer up towards where you aim; you dash after it, catch it and hurl it down at the nearest foe there, where lightning runs out in a wide V.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.call.name: Call Lightning
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.call: While your storm lasts: a bolt strikes where you aim.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.calm.name: End the Storm
guide.welcomescreen.thor.fists.calm: Your storm clears away at once.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.title: Hammer
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.in: Press the scroll wheel on the ground.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.out: Press it again to hang the hammer back on your belt.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.blocked: Thunderclap, Dash, Grab and Grab Dash: they need empty hands.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.combo: A wide swing, a backhand, a thrust with the head and an overhead smash with a thunder crack.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.uppercut: Launches whatever stands before you high into the air.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.throw: Throws the hammer at the crosshair; it flies back to your hand by itself.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.stay: Throws the hammer, which stays where it stops: on the ground, stuck in a wall or hanging in the air.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.follow: Hold to draw back, let go to throw: lightning pulls you after it. Near the ground you land by it; in the air you fly on with it.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.away: Hangs the hammer back on your belt.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.charge: Its blows, uppercut and throws hit harder while its runes glow.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.jump: A huge leap, as with your fists.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.storm: Calls up a thunderstorm over you that follows you, with rain and a dark sky under it. Now and then it strikes foes under it by itself.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.bomb: You rise slowly with bolts striking round you, charge up and burst: everything round and under you is hurt, thrown and knocked down. Only on the ground.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.storm_th: Flings the hammer up towards where you aim; you dash after it, catch it and hurl it down at the nearest foe there, where lightning runs out in a wide V.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.call: While your storm lasts: a bolt strikes where you aim.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.hammer.calm: Your storm clears away at once.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.title: Hammer Thrown
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.in: Throw the hammer: it is away while it flies, rests or comes back.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.out:
Press the scroll wheel to call it back.
Hold jump: it flies into your hand and you take off.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.blocked: Take Up the Hammer and Charge: the hammer is not on you.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.notes:
Thrown to stay, it waits until you call it or go too far from it.
You fight with your fists meanwhile.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.combo: The next blow of your fist combo: punches, elbows and kicks, with big finishers later on.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.clap: Winds up and claps: a Thunderclap blasts away everything in a cone where you aim.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.dash: Dashes low along the ground the way you walk, or straight ahead when you stand still.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.grab: Grabs the nearest creature in front of you by the throat. Then pick a finish within 1.5 seconds (see Holding), or one is picked at random.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.grab_das: Dashes straight ahead and grabs whatever you pass. Pick a finish as with Grab.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.recall: Calls the hammer back to your hand. It hits every creature in its path once.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.follow: Lightning pulls you to it; one still flying stops in the air for you. In the air you catch it and fly on.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.jump: A huge leap, as with the hammer on you.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.fly: Calls the hammer into your raised left hand, then takes off.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.storm: Calls up a thunderstorm over you that follows you, with rain and a dark sky under it. Now and then it strikes foes under it by itself.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.bomb: You rise slowly with bolts striking round you, charge up and burst: everything round and under you is hurt, thrown and knocked down. Only on the ground.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.call: While your storm lasts: a bolt strikes where you aim.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.thrown.calm: Your storm clears away at once.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.title: Holding
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.in: Grab a creature: hold the use button, or catch one with Grab Dash.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.out: The finish ends it by itself.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.blocked: Your blows, Dash and the hammer key: your hand is full.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.notes:
Pick within 1.5 seconds of grabbing: the bar under the crosshair runs out.
Pick nothing and a finish is chosen at random.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.punches: Punches it three times with your free hand, then lets it drop.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.throw.name: Throw
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.throw: Lifts it high and hurls it away the way you look.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.slam.name: Head Slam
guide.welcomescreen.thor.held.slam: Lifts it up and drives it head first into the ground before you.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.title: Flight
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.in: Hold jump, on the ground or in the air.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.out:
Fly down onto the ground.
A Grab-Dash Dive or a hard hit also ends it.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.blocked: Your ground moves, the hammer key, Charge, Super Jump and the Lightning Bomb.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.notes:
With no key held you hang still; to go down, look down and fly forward.
Your own flight never hurts you with a fall.
While a Storm Throw is out, only your right hand's blows work.
Without the hammer in your hand for over a second, you drop out of the sky.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.blows: One-handed blows with your right hand.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.shockwav: A ball of lightning around you; all it hits goes limp and drops to the ground for 3 seconds.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.blink: A short lightning jump the way you steer, or along your look.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.dive: Dives at what you aim at, grabs it and slams it into the ground. It ends your flight.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.call: While your storm lasts: a bolt strikes where you aim.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.calm: Your storm clears away at once.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.bolt: Calls a lightning bolt down on the creature you aim at.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.storm_th: Raises the hammer and hurls it at most 6 blocks; where it strikes the ground, lightning runs out in a wide V. Then it flies back to you.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.storm: Calls up a thunderstorm over you that follows you, with rain and a dark sky under it. Now and then it strikes foes under it by itself.
guide.welcomescreen.thor.flight.lightnin: You become a bolt of lightning and fly far faster, striking hostile creatures you pass close by. It ends after a while (you fly on as normal), when you start a dive, or close over the ground, where you land by yourself with a strike that throws everything back.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.title: Ground
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.in: Your normal state: on your own feet with all four tentacles free, or on two, three or four tentacles once you switch stance.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.out:
Walk into a wall to climb it.
Grab something to hold it.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.notes:
Every tentacle you walk on is one less free for abilities; with three or four legs, one lifts off to do an ability while the others carry you.
No fall damage while the tentacles carry you.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.hit: A normal hit, made by a tentacle lashing out from further away than usual.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.use: Uses and places as normal, also from further away.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.grab: A tentacle grabs the creature you aim at, or the nearest enemy ahead.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.multi: Every free tentacle strikes the creature you aim at.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.dash: The tentacles launch you the way you are moving.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.block: All four tentacles hold an energy shield in front of you.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.slam: The tentacles smash down around you and throw everything back.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.porta: A tentacle goes through a portal and slams the creature you aim at down from the sky.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.rampa: Your ultimate: attacks twice as fast, and the tentacles fight by themselves.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.stanc: Next stance: on two, three, then four tentacles, then back on your feet.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.strik: On a creature: marks it, glowing through walls, one per free tentacle. At nothing: a tentacle dives under the ground to each mark and bursts up under it.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.ground.climb: Walk into a wall and the claws hook in to climb it.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.title: Climbing
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.in: Walk into a wall, or jump up against a roof.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.out:
Push off.
Reach the top: you hop over.
Run out of stamina.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.notes: No fall damage while you hang on.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.push: Lets go and pushes off; against a roof, hooks into the ceiling.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.grab: A tentacle grabs the creature you aim at, or the nearest enemy ahead.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.multi: Every free tentacle strikes the creature you aim at.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.dash: The tentacles launch you the way you are moving.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.block: All four tentacles hold an energy shield in front of you.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.slam: The tentacles smash down around you and throw everything back.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.portal: A tentacle goes through a portal and slams the creature you aim at down from the sky.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.rampag: Your ultimate: attacks twice as fast, and the tentacles fight by themselves.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.climb.strike: On a creature: marks it, glowing through walls, one per free tentacle. At nothing: a tentacle dives under the ground to each mark and bursts up under it.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.out:
Throw them.
Let go of everything.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.bloc: Your normal hit: attack throws instead.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.note: Other abilities only use the tentacles that are still free.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.swin: Swing your view to whip what you hold along; hitting a wall, the ceiling or the ground hurts it.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.thro: Throws everything you hold where you look.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.more: Grabs one more with the next free tentacle.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.slam: Drives everything you hold down into the ground.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.norm: A normal slam around you, and you keep hold.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.mult: Every free tentacle strikes the creature you aim at.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.dash: The tentacles launch you the way you are moving.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.bloc: All four tentacles hold an energy shield in front of you.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.port: A tentacle goes through a portal and slams the creature you aim at down from the sky.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.ramp: Your ultimate: attacks twice as fast, and the tentacles fight by themselves.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.stan: Next stance: on two, three, then four tentacles, then back on your feet.
guide.welcomescreen.doc_ock.holding.stri: On a creature: marks it, glowing through walls, one per free tentacle. At nothing: a tentacle dives under the ground to each mark and bursts up under it.

config.welcomescreen.about.game: Client: only in your own game, in every world.
config.welcomescreen.about.world: Server: saved with this world, for everyone in it.
config.welcomescreen.host_only.desc: The world's own settings. Only its host or a listed owner can open them, while in that world.
config.welcomescreen.steps: Hold shift for 10 steps at once.
config.welcomescreen.locked: The settings file is not open, so nothing can be saved here.
config.welcomescreen.denied: Only the host or an owner may change the server settings.
config.welcomescreen.general.damageMulti: Multiplies the damage of every ability. 1 = as set per ability, 0 = no damage.
config.welcomescreen.general.cooldownMul: Multiplies the cooldown of every ability. 1 = as set per ability, 0 = no cooldowns.
config.welcomescreen.general.breakBlocks: Whether powers may break blocks at all.
config.welcomescreen.general.fatigueKnoc: Blows one after another tire a creature: it sags more with every hit, and the fifth quick hit drops it as if thrown; it lies a while and gets up. Off = it only tires.
config.welcomescreen.general.dominoKnock: A thrown creature that crashes into another passes on its push, by their weight, and knocks that one down too. Off = as in the plain game.
config.welcomescreen.general.playerKnock: Players go limp as creatures do, the same in every player's game: knocked down by a power, or thrown really hard by a blow or a blast, they fall, lie a second and get up; a dying player's body falls limp. Never in creative, while riding, gliding or flying, in water or lava, or from your own blast. Off = players never go limp.
config.welcomescreen.general.green_lante: Whether Green Lantern can be chosen. Switched off, whoever is him turns back into themselves.
config.welcomescreen.general.doc_ock.des: Whether Doctor Octopus can be chosen. Switched off, whoever is him turns back into themselves.
config.welcomescreen.general.thor.desc: Whether Thor can be chosen. Switched off, whoever is him turns back into themselves.
character.welcomescreen.switched_off: %s is switched off in this world
config.welcomescreen.client.themeMusic.d: Play the multiverse theme in the main menu. Off = the game's own menu music.
config.welcomescreen.client.voiceLines.d: Characters speak their lines, such as Green Lantern's ring as he arrives, flies or takes up a weapon. Off = they never speak.
How loud the characters' spoken lines are. 0 = silent. The game's own Voice/Speech slider scales them too.
config.welcomescreen.client.updateCheckM: How often the game looks for a new version of the mod, in minutes: no more often than every 5.
config.welcomescreen.client.updatePopupS: How long the note about a new version stays on screen while you play. 0 = only in the menus.
How hard your view shakes and jolts from the powers: a slam, crash or blast nearby, a sword blow, the beam, the ring arriving. 1 = as made, 0 = never.
config.welcomescreen.client.ramGroundSha: How hard your view shakes while you fly with the ram cone low along the ground (0 = not at all); the camera shake scales it too.
config.welcomescreen.client.mechCinemati: While your mech builds itself, the camera films it shot after shot like a movie, then hands you the view from its cockpit. Off = keep your own view.
config.welcomescreen.client.ragdolls.des: Creatures go limp: they fall, tumble and hang from what holds them, and a body stays where it fell before it sinks away. Off = as in the plain game. Players go limp by the world's own setting, Players go limp.
How many limp creatures and bodies there may be at once; bodies that have lain still long enough sink away first, then the furthest living ones let go.
config.welcomescreen.client.corpseSecond: How long a body lies where it fell before it sinks into the ground: at least 5 seconds of lying wholly still; if it moves again (a block broken under it), the count starts over.
config.welcomescreen.client.ragdollReach: How far away a creature may be and still go limp.
config.welcomescreen.client.ragdollDetai: Limp bodies nearer than this move in full detail; further ones move a little simpler, to save time, and make no sound.
config.welcomescreen.client.ragdollForce: How hard blows and blasts throw limp bodies.
config.welcomescreen.client.ragdollThuds: Limp bodies thud when they hit the ground or a wall, as loud as the hit was hard, and throw up the block's dust. Off = silent.
config.welcomescreen.client.wallSlump.de: A creature knocked back against a wall slams into it and slides down into a slump against it. Off = it falls as anywhere else.
config.welcomescreen.client.capeCloth.de: Capes are cloth: they hang, trail and swing as players run and turn, and fold against their back and legs. Off = the game's stiff cape.
config.welcomescreen.client.footPlanting: Feet rest on the ground they stand on: a foot never sinks into a step, and a spider's legs reach down to the ground. Off = as in the plain game.
How bright the screen flashes when a blast or a thunderclap goes off near you. 0 = never.
config.welcomescreen.client.particleAmou: How many particles the powers throw up: sparks, dust, smoke, splashes. 0 = none.
config.welcomescreen.client.effectDetail: How much detail the biggest effects have: the thunderclap's streaks, the flamethrower's flames.
config.welcomescreen.defaults.desc: Put every setting in the list back to the mod's own. Nothing is saved until you save or close the window.
config.welcomescreen.undo.desc: Drop every change not saved yet.
config.welcomescreen.save.desc: Save every change on every page. Closing the window saves them too.
config.welcomescreen.cooldown.desc: How long you wait before you can use it again.
config.welcomescreen.damage.desc: How much its main hit does, in half hearts.
How much stamina a full bar holds.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.sprintDrain: Stamina sprinting costs per tick (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.welcomescreen.stamina.regenPerTic: Stamina that comes back per tick while you rest.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.regenDelayT: How long you have to rest before stamina comes back.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.exhaustionR: Stamina you need again before you can sprint after running out.

screen.welcomescreen.title: Welkom
screen.welcomescreen.group_hint: Where your power comes from. Click to see its classes.
screen.welcomescreen.class_hint: How you use that power. Click a class to pick it.
screen.welcomescreen.notice.title: ⚠ Your class is not a cage ⚠
screen.welcomescreen.notice.body: Your class only decides your skill tree: how you grow and which powers you unlock. It never locks anything away. A Knight can still cast spells, a Wizard can still wear heavy armour, and anyone can use any weapon, potion or item from any group.
screen.welcomescreen.notice.short: ⚠ Your class only shapes your skill tree. Every weapon, spell and item stays open to you.
screen.welcomescreen.inventory.hint: Your class shapes your skill tree only - nothing is locked.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.lore: No gods, no spirits, no tricks - just a body trained to survive where others break.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.power: Your own body. Armour, weapons and endurance - no magic at all.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.pick: you want to be in the middle of the fight and simply hit hard.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.lore: They know the wild better than themselves: a bow, an animal, and the land itself.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.power: The wild. Range, animals, traps and knowing the land.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.pick: you like fighting from a distance, exploring, or having a companion.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.lore: They live off what others do not see. No honour, no rules - only what works.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.power: Stealth and cunning. Surprise, speed and dirty tricks.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.pick: you want to strike first, stay unseen and never fight fair.
group.welcomescreen.mages.lore: Arcane power, gained in four ways: learned, born, borrowed and taken.
group.welcomescreen.mages.power: Magic. Spells that hit hard from range, in a fragile body.
group.welcomescreen.mages.pick: you want big spells and can keep enemies away from you.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.lore: Their power does not come from themselves, but from what they believe.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.power: Faith. Healing, holy light and power against the undead.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.pick: you want to protect, heal, or hunt what should not exist.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.lore: They rarely fight head-on - they win another way.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.power: Potions and powders. Healing brews, poison, bombs and crafting.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.pick: you like preparing, brewing and winning with the right mix.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.lore: Wakes up with nothing, and no memory of who he was.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.power: A little of everything: fragments of all six groups.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.pick: you want no fixed role and the hardest possible start.
class.welcomescreen.knight.lore: The wall - still standing when everyone else falls.
class.welcomescreen.knight.special: Draws enemies to himself and blocks with shield and heavy armour.
class.welcomescreen.knight.pick: you want to survive anything and protect others.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.lore: The more he bleeds, the more dangerous he gets.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.special: Rage: hits harder the lower his health is.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.weak: Little defence - easy to push too far.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.lore: Calm, patient, deadly - a long pole with a sharp end.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.special: Long reach: hits enemies before they can hit back.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.strong: Keeps enemies at a safe distance.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.pick: you like controlled fighting and good positioning.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.lore: Wins by never getting hit - then strikes at the perfect moment.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.special: Dodges and parries, followed by a strong counter-attack.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.strong: Very hard to hit in a one-on-one fight.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.pick: you want skill and timing over raw strength.
class.welcomescreen.archer.lore: By the time something notices him, it is already too late.
class.welcomescreen.archer.special: Precise bow shots from long range.
class.welcomescreen.archer.strong: The most damage from a distance.
class.welcomescreen.archer.pick: you want to kill things before they reach you.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.lore: Never fights alone - something loyal and wild walks beside him.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.special: Animal companions that fight beside him and grow with him.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.weak: Weaker on his own when his animal falls.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.pick: you want a loyal animal partner.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.lore: Wins the fight before it starts. The ground is his weapon.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.special: Traps and snares that slow, catch and hurt enemies.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.strong: Very strong when prepared, great for defence.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.pick: you like planning ahead and luring enemies in.
class.welcomescreen.scout.lore: Sees everything before anyone else does.
class.welcomescreen.scout.special: Speed, sharp sight and spotting danger early.
class.welcomescreen.scout.strong: The fastest explorer, finds things first.
class.welcomescreen.scout.weak: Low damage in a straight fight.
class.welcomescreen.scout.pick: you love exploring and moving fast.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.lore: Invisible until it is too late. One mistake is enough.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.special: Sneak attacks from hiding that deal massive damage.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.strong: Kills a single target very fast.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.weak: Fragile if the first strike fails.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.pick: you want to strike once, hard, from the shadows.
class.welcomescreen.thief.lore: Every door has a lock, and every lock has a way in.
class.welcomescreen.thief.special: Lockpicking and stealing: more loot, fewer fights.
class.welcomescreen.thief.strong: Gets rich fast and avoids danger.
class.welcomescreen.thief.pick: you care more about treasure than about fighting.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.lore: Waits in the shadow of the road.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.special: Ambushes with crossbow shots and surprise attacks.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.strong: A deadly first strike from range.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.weak: Weak in a long, open fight.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.pick: you like ambushes and a crossbow.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.lore: Walks in where nobody may enter, and leaves no trace.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.special: Sneaks past guards into places others cannot reach.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.pick: you want to sneak instead of fight.
class.welcomescreen.wizard.lore: Learned it all from books, and is never done learning.
class.welcomescreen.wizard.special: Many kinds of spells: fire, ice, light and more.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.lore: Born with magic nobody taught him.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.special: Fewer spells than a Wizard, but much stronger ones.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.weak: Few options, needs rest to recover.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.pick: you want pure, raw magic power.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.lore: Borrowed his power from something that is not human.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.special: Strong dark spells that always come with a price.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.pick: you like risk and dark power.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.special: Raises the dead and curses enemies. Grows with every kill.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.strong: An army of minions, stronger in long fights.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.weak: Weak alone, and weak at the start.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.pick: you want an army of the dead.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.lore: Without him, a hard fight falls apart.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.special: Healing and blessings for himself and others.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.strong: The best at keeping everyone alive.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.pick: you want to keep others standing.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.lore: A Knight's armour, but he fights with faith, not steel.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.special: Heavy armour plus holy power against evil.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.strong: Tough, and extra strong against undead.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.pick: you want to be a holy warrior.
class.welcomescreen.inquisitor.special: Extra strong against the undead and forbidden magic.
class.welcomescreen.inquisitor.pick: you want to hunt the undead and the dark.
class.welcomescreen.monk.lore: Needs no weapon and no armour - only discipline.
class.welcomescreen.monk.special: Fights with fists and speed, stronger without gear.
class.welcomescreen.monk.pick: you want a pure challenge without gear.
class.welcomescreen.apothecary.lore: Unremarkable, until the moment everyone needs him.
class.welcomescreen.plague_doctor.lore: Makes the enemy weaken itself before the fight starts.
class.welcomescreen.plague_doctor.specia: Poison and sickness that wear enemies down over time.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.lore: Subtlety is not his strong suit.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.special: Bombs that hit many enemies at once.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.weak: Dangerous up close - also to himself.
class.welcomescreen.transmuter.special: Changes materials into other, more useful ones.
class.welcomescreen.transmuter.pick: you like crafting and building more than fighting.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.lore: No group claims him. He does not know himself where he belongs.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.special: Fragments of skills from every group.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.strong: The most flexible: can grow into anything.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.weak: Starts with nothing, no clear strength.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.pick: you want the hardest start and total freedom.
screen.welcomescreen.construct_pick.help: Click one: a second later it strikes in front of you, shockwave and all.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.fist.desc: A giant fist smashes down out of the sky, knuckles first.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.hands.desc: Two giant hands clap together in front of you.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.fists.desc: Two giant fists bump knuckles in front of you.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.hammer.desc: A war hammer drops head first; sparks fly.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.emblem.desc: The lantern emblem stands up and falls flat on its face.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.anvil.desc: An anvil drops, squashes, throws sparks and hops once more.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.cymbals.des: Two cymbals crash together and ring.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.uppercut.de: A giant fist bursts up out of the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.spikes.desc: Two rings of crystal spikes shoot up out of the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.boot.desc: A boot stamps down heel first; the toe slaps after.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.weight.desc: A cartoon ton weight drops with a heavy squash.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.sword.desc: A sword drops point first and stays in the ground, quivering.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.rockets.des: Five rockets arc over your head and come down one after another.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.swatter.des: A fly swatter swings over your shoulder and slaps the ground flat.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.lantern.des: Your lantern drops, its handle swinging.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.safe.desc: A safe drops, its door flies open and money spills out.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.anchor.desc: An anchor drops; its chain comes down after it and piles up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.mace.desc: A spiked ball tumbles down and rocks in the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.barbell.des: A barbell drops on its plates and bounces.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.bell.desc: A bell drops on its rim and rings, its clapper swinging.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.meteor.desc: A burning meteor streaks in and slams into the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.palm.desc: A giant open hand slaps the ground; its fingers drum after.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.gavel.desc: A judge's gavel strikes its block, and knocks once more.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.pickaxe.des: A pickaxe swings over your head and bites into the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.trap.desc: The jaws of a bear trap snap shut.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.book.desc: A giant book flips its pages and slams shut.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.drum.desc: Two drumsticks strike a drum and play a roll.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.pillar.desc: A pillar bursts out of the ground and topples; its drums come apart.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.tnt.desc: A bundle of dynamite lands, its fuse burns down, and it blows up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.piano.desc: A piano drops; its lids fly open and notes float up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.brick.desc: A giant toy brick drops and bounces.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.stamp.desc: A rubber stamp stamps the lantern emblem into the ground.
